description: Header file defining the 'Service' class within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including nested 'Config' class, with methods for plugin configuration, web server setup, state management, and notification handling.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with configuration, state management, web server hosting, and notification capabilities within the Thunder plugin framework.

nested_classes.name: Config
nested_classes.description: Handles plugin configuration parameters such as paths, start mode, and web prefix, with methods to update and access these settings.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the plugin's locator string from configuration.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the plugin's class name from configuration.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the plugin's callsign from configuration.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix URL for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Gets or sets the plugin's configuration line.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Gets or sets the system root path.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the plugin service.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is resumed; sets the resumed state.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message, if any.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Fills a Metadata::Service object with current service metadata.

methods.name: IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request segment is for the web server.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to subscribed channels.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements; pure virtual function.
